targets.query:
import "strings"

from(bucket: "comodo")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mqtt_consumer")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.topic =~ /^heartbeat\/.*/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "status")
  |> map(fn: (r) => {
      parts = strings.split(v: r.topic, t: "/")
      lastIndex = length(arr: parts) - 1
      return { r with topic_last: parts[lastIndex] }
    })
  |> keep(columns: ["_time","_value","topic_last"])
  |> group(columns: ["topic_last"], mode: "by")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "last")

from(bucket: "comodo")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "mqtt_consumer")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["topic"] == "measurement/furnace_centre/temperature")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "furnace_centre temperature"}))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")
